'''Karn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] settler and [[Farmer/Legends|farmer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muzara]]. He came to the planet with his family&mdash;his [[Karn's wife|wife]], his brother-in-law [[Tallov Kersk]], Tallov's [[Tallov Kersk's wife|wife]], his daughter [[Cavvie]], and his nephew [[Vettle]]<ref name="RKD" />&mdash;in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].<ref name="CSWE II 346">{{CSWECite|II|346|Muzara}}</ref> Karn and his family became the first settlers from the [[Brentaal League]] to encounter the planet's native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Muza]].<ref name="RKD" />
